block: 1 remainder — the four cases resolved by directive 0025

provenDefectOfThePreviousVersion: The case had no assertion at all; it awaited a task and discarded the result.

It could not work as written: setting the content type of the send context only writes the transport header, while the body stays serialized by the endpoint serializer, and an unknown media type falls back to the default deserializer. The envelope therefore deserialized and the ping was consumed normally. The doc comment named this: it required a debugger to appear to pass.
newAssurance: The content type is application/vnd.vicione.servicebus+msgpack, which a default in memory endpoint provably does not register; it registers exactly one media type.
The body is written unchanged and is not an envelope, so the deserializer the endpoint falls back to fails as well.

The receive fault is asserted with the content type that could not be read, the identifier of the message that could not be read, a non empty fault identifier, the host, exactly one exception of type System.Runtime.Serialization.SerializationException, and the address of the endpoint that produced it.
The handler task for the regular message is retained instead of discarded and is asserted to be incomplete, which is the proof that the payload was never processed as a regular message.

removedNonDeterminism: no assertion; the returned bus control was dropped and the only statement was that configuring does not throw
the bus was never started and never stopped, so two fully built buses leaked per fixture run
the consumer of the fixture threw NotImplementedException, which was harmless only as long as nothing was ever delivered
declarations.newAssurance: The bus is started, its probe reports the pipeline that was actually built, and the bus is stopped on every path. Asserted from the probe: the transform, transaction, retry, saga and instance filters exist, every configured concurrency limit (3, 7, 1) and every configured rate limit (1000, 100) appears, the saga persistence is the in memory repository, and the registered consumer type is present.
declarations.renameReason: Directive 0025 requires a domain name instead of FirstTestName; old and new identity are bound here.

declarations.newAssurance: The endpoint concurrency limit is applied per configured message type. The case proves that a consumer registered as an instance registers its message types like any other consumer, so the built pipeline carries the instance filter and a concurrency limit of five.

removedNonDeterminism: the rendering went into the output stream of the test runner and was never inspected
no deterministic teardown of the harness
declarations.newAssurance: The timeline is written into a writer of this test. The flow is closed by a barrier on the nine leaf messages that follow from the topology, and the rendering is asserted structurally: one published root of the first type, three of the second, three of the third, three sends of the fourth and nine of the leaf, with the matching consume rows, and every consume row reports the endpoint that handled it.
declarations.structuralConfirmation: The nine counts were derived from the consumer topology before the first run and matched the rendering exactly.

removedNonDeterminism: a hardcoded external host address that is unreachable outside one machine
a load loop of one hundred thousand increments
DateTime.Now at both ends and a throughput division that can divide by zero
the console as the only output, and no assertion
declarations.newAssurance: A receiver owned by this case is bound on the loopback address and on an ephemeral port before the counter is constructed, because the counter connects its socket in its constructor. The three datagrams for Increment, IncrementBy and Set are compared byte for byte, which proves the composed counter name and the metric type marker of each operation, including that Set writes a gauge and not a StatsD set.
declarations.publicSurface: unchanged; no StatsD type or member was touched
declarations.renameReason: The previous name stated no contract. Old and new identity are bound here.
flakinessGuards: the literal loopback address on both sides, because a host name can resolve to the other address family
an ephemeral port, so a local agent or a parallel run cannot collide
the receiver is bound first, because a connected datagram socket reports an unbound target on a later send
the counter is disposed only after every datagram arrived, because disposing closes the socket underneath the sends the product does not await
the datagrams are compared as a set, because nothing in the product orders them
a socket receive timeout instead of a delay, and the failure names how many datagrams were missing

provenProductDefect.statement: OutputTimelineOptions.Now() cannot make the timeline render immediately, although that is its documented purpose.
provenProductDefect.cause: AsyncInactivityObserver.InactivityTask is a Lazy that is first created inside the await of OutputTimeline, after Apply has already called ForceInactive. Its factory is TimeoutTask, which begins with an unconditional Task.Delay over the full inactivity timeout before it ever looks at the completion source that ForceInactive already set.
provenProductDefect.measurement: The case runs in exactly the configured inactivity timeout: 10 s with a ten second timeout, 3 s with a three second timeout, for a message flow that completes in milliseconds.
provenProductDefect.consequence: Every use of OutputTimeline pays one full inactivity period, whether or not Now() was requested.
provenProductDefect.handling: No product change was made. The assignment requires a QUESTION on a proven product defect before any product change, so this is reported and the case bounds the cost with a three second inactivity timeout. The oracle of the case is its assertion set, not the duration.

remainingExplicitDeclarations.note: All four are the benchmark migrations of block 3 and nothing else.
